newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to offer up to 12 mln in 91 day t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to offer up to 12 mln in 91 day t-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will offer up to 12 million pounds ($25.8 million) in 91-day treasury bills with a December 11 issue date, the bank said on Monday.
Bids, which can be competitive or non-competitive, can be made from December 9 until December 11 at 0900 local time (0700 GMT).

Competitive bids will be accepted either in part or in whole if the price is equal or higher than that set by the central bank. Those making non-competitive bids will pay the average price of all bids submitted and accepted by the central bank.
Treasury bill auctions are held every second and third Wednesday of the month.
